svg.title: P1 PCB component-side orientation and pin-one map
svg.desc: Actual generated footprint positions. Left pressure sensors face outward to the left, right sensors to the right. Red marks identify pin one; the two Pico socket pin-one positions are at the USB end.

g.text: Component side · red marks = pin 1 · confirm physical parts before soldering
A → back of the same CH
Both start at the USB end.
Generated from the actual board component/pad positions. This is an assembly guide, not a copper mask or a physical board photograph.
